5.2.2 Single configuration value in multiple containers The example in listing 5.11 illustrates the definition of an Integration Requirements which may be applied several times: CanIfRxPduDataLengthCheck is a boolean configuration parameter defined as part of the configuration container CanIfRxP- duCfg. CanIfRxPduCfg has an upper multiplicity greater than 1, thus many instances of CanIfRxPduCfg may exists in an ecu configuration values model. CanIfRxPduDataLengthCheck CanIfRxPduDataLengthCheck REQUIREMENT_ITEM 2025-02-20 OEM valid mandatory

This parameter switches the message specific data length check. True: Data length check will be executed during the reception of this PDU. False: No data length check will be executed during the reception of this PDU.
